title: Verify pytest collection and assertion reachability before suite claims
applies_when: A Python repository adds tests under a different filename convention, uses optional external capabilities, a diagnostic wrapper changes pytest plugin startup, or a green directory run is being used to qualify a supposedly included behavior.
lesson: Read effective pytest configuration and actual collected case identities before interpreting a green suite. At the cited Voluptuous revision, python_files='tests.py' excludes test_dataclasses.py from the directory command used by tox, although that file passes when selected alone. Existing PR #555 acknowledges the omission and places its regressions in the collected file; do not rediscover its Optional repair. Require an intended case from each relevant file, not just an unrelated sentinel or aggregate count. A directory-plus-file argument list is not collection proof: inspect the report. Declare deliberately expanded selections separately, keep identical tests/configuration in both arms, and retain missing-case results. Collection is still insufficient: DiskCache's two test_rsync functions return normally when the executable is absent, before any transfer assertions. Such nodes are reported passed, not skipped. Check the relevant worker capability or behavioral witness before claiming that route was exercised; retain raw report counters and state the unexecuted coverage separately.
avoid_when: A missing case is not a failed assertion; neither is an early optional return. Neither permits rewriting reports or silently relaxing required identities. A later expanded run does not retroactively qualify an earlier selection. Do not pre-import plugins merely to record their paths before pytest registration: PytestAssertRewriteWarning under -W=error can abort before collection. Prefer a fresh CLI process, or inspect actual module identities after registration; do not suppress the project's warnings to rescue the trial. Correct collection does not establish production import identity, assertion reachability, optional dependencies, CI approval, maintainer acceptance, or measured Scout accuracy/cost improvement. Do not change import mode or skip tests just to get green. The rsync example is a conditional source mechanism, not a claim that every green node is suspect or that those external operations ran on another host.

evidence.note: The documented import hook rewrites plugin modules during pytest startup; registration after an earlier import can emit a warning. This explains an initialization hazard, not an upstream target failure or a measured Scout benefit. Preserve strict warning settings and the actual failed setup.
Pinned pytest configuration sets python_files='tests.py' and testpaths to voluptuous/tests. This is collection-mechanism evidence, not a full-suite local pass.
The Python tox command selects the test directory, so the effective filename pattern matters.

Existing author's report distinguishes the normal 190-case selection from 19 explicitly invoked dataclass tests and places eight new cases in the normally collected file. This is prior author-owned work, not our new Optional finding or endorsement of its entire fix.
Official pytest documentation describes filename/class/function collection conventions and checking collected tests. Check the actual installed version and resulting identities.

test_rsync catches OSError from rsync --version and returns before transfer/assertions. A passed pytest node does not establish rsync coverage when the binary is absent; this source alone does not report any worker's installed capabilities.
The FanoutCache rsync test has the same ordinary-return optional capability path. Retain the producer's pass count but distinguish the unexecuted branch.
